title: Higher-Order Time Differentiation Property of the Laplace Transform
expert_review: A critical theoretical result that generalizes the differentiation property and enables Laplace-based solution of high-order differential equations.
learning_objectives: Generalize the differentiation property to higher-order derivatives
Understand the recursive structure of Laplace transform properties
Relate initial conditions to Laplace-domain expressions
Apply the result to high-order differential equations in system analysis
